text: depression overtakes him, and this depression is so bad that [[Amr|عمرو]] is not able to sleep at all in the night. He can't sleep.

And during the day, he is so weak and tired and fatigued because he doesn't have any sleep in the night. So he suffers from such an extreme case of insomnia that he is not able to actually function in his life properly.

Now, before [[Amr|عمرو]] actually went through with the plot to execute his brother, to assassinate his brother, just before the time came for the assassination, [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]], who was trying his best to convince him not to go through with this plot,
he said to him, 'Okay, you're not listening to me, but I'm writing a letter, and I'm sealing this letter and giving it to you as an [[amanah|أمانة]].
So keep this letter with you, and when I tell you to open it, then open it.' So [[Amr|عمرو]] said, 'Okay,' and he kept that letter with him.

And after that, he went ahead with the assassination plot, and he killed his brother. So now, after the assassination, he's suffering from this depression and this sadness, so he calls the best doctors of [[Yemen|اليمن]] and the specialists and everyone to come and try to treat him for this problem that he's having, this lack of sleep.

And all of the doctors and specialists and everyone agreed that the reason why [[Amr|عمرو]] is suffering from this type of depression is obviously because of the evil act that he did, the fact that he murdered his own brother in order to take over his kingdom.

This is something that would destroy anyone psychologically to do such a thing. So all of the doctors and all of the specialists that he brought, they agreed that, 'Yes, the cause of your insomnia, the cause of your inability to sleep, the cause of your depression is because of this crime that you committed, because you killed your brother.'
So [[Amr|عمرو]] said, 'Okay, I understand that. I know what the problem is. That's not what I called you here for. I called you for a solution. What should I do about it now?'

And they said to him, 'The only solution you have is everyone who conspired, everyone who came to you and convinced you to kill your brother, the people who came up with this plan, you have to kill all of them.'

'The ones who made you do this, you have to execute each and every one of them, and then you should be okay.' So he said, 'Okay, no problem. I'll do that. I'll kill every one of them. Everyone who conspired with me to murder my brother, I will kill each last one of them.'

So he started to kill all of those cabinet ministers one by one. He executed them each one by one. And then [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]]'s turn came to be executed. But as we know, [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]] was the one who told him not to do it.

But when his turn came, he was about to be executed as well. So [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]], he said, 'Wait, wait. O [[Amr|عمرو]], before you execute me, before you kill me, I just need you to do one thing.' He said, 'Okay, what is that?'

He said, 'Remember, before the assassination, I gave you a sealed letter?' He said, 'Yes, I remember.' He said, 'Okay, I told you to keep that as an [[amanah|أمانة]], to keep that as a trust, and not to open it until I tell you to open it.' He said, 'Yes, I remember that.' He said, 'Okay, now, before you kill me, I need you to open that letter and read that letter.'
So he said, 'Okay.' He took the letter and he opened it, and he found two lines of poetry. Two lines of poetry written on that piece of paper. The two lines of poetry, they said:

ar:
أَلَا مَنْ يَشْتَرِي سَهَرًا بِنَوْمٍ ... سَعِيدٌ مَنْ يَبِيتُ قَرِيرَ عَيْنِ 
 فَأَمَّا حِمْيَرٌ غَدَرَتْ وَخَانَتْ ... فَمَعْذِرَةُ الْإِلَهِ لِذِي رُعَيْنِ
translit: Ala man yashtari saharan bi-nawmin, sa'idun man yabitu qarira 'ayni. Fa-amma Himyaru ghadarat wa-khanat, fa-ma'dhiratu al-ilahi li-Dhi Ru'ayni.

text: So these two beautiful lines of poetry that [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]] wrote, it means, 'Who would be crazy enough to purchase the inability to sleep, to purchase insomnia, and buy that with their sleep? Basically, to trade a comfortable night's sleep for the inability to sleep? Who would do that?'

'If you're sleeping comfortably, this is a great blessing. So why would you sell your ability to sleep comfortably and trade it for a life with no comfort? [[Sa'idun man yabitu qarira 'ayni|سعيد من يبيت قرير عين]]—the happy person is the person who is able to sleep comfortably. It doesn't matter how rich you are, it doesn't matter how powerful you are, if you're not able to even sleep in the night, you'll never be happy.'

'Even a person who doesn't have much wealth, he doesn't have much riches, he doesn't have any power, but he's able to sleep comfortably in the night, that's the happy person, rather than the most powerful person in the world who is unable to even sleep in the night. [[Sa'idun man yabitu qarira 'ayni|سعيد من يبيت قرير عين]]—the happy person is the one who is able to sleep comfortably.'

'[[Fa-amma Himyar ghadarat wa-khanat|فأما حمير غدرت وخانت]]—as for [[Himyar|حمير]], [[Himyar|حمير]] means [[Ahl Yemen|أهل اليمن]], the people of [[Yemen|اليمن]]. As for the people of [[Yemen|اليمن]], meaning the ministries, the cabinet, [[fa-ghadarat wa-khanat|فغدرت وخانت]], these people betrayed and committed treason.'

'[[Fa-ma'dhiratul-ilahi li-Dhi Ru'ayni|فمعذرة الإله لذي رعين]]—except [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]]. Except [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]]. [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]] is the one who told you not to go through with this. Do you remember that?'

And when he read, when [[Amr|عمرو]] read these two lines of poetry, he remembered the advice of [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]] to him before he killed his brother, that he was the only one who told him not to go through with it. But he didn't heed that advice, he didn't listen to [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]], and he went ahead and did it anyways. So once those two lines of poetry reminded [[Amr|عمرو]] of [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]]'s stance on this whole issue, he said, 'Yes, you're right. [[Sadaqta|صدقت]]. You have spoken the truth. And you are pardoned.' And he didn't kill [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]]. So [[Dhu Ru'ayn|ذو رعين]] survived because of that.

So [[Amr|عمرو]] continued as the king of [[Yemen|اليمن]], but when he died, when [[Amr|عمرو]] died, then the fighting started. Then the descendants of [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربيعة بن نصر]], who we spoke about last week, they started fighting over the kingdom of [[Yemen|اليمن]].

They didn't think that it should go to the next one in line, rather each one from the royal family thought that they had a claim to that kingdom. So nobody wanted to give it to any other members of the family for rule. So the civil war started. So the family of [[Rabiah ibn Nasr|ربيعة بن نصر]], they started to fight over who should rule [[Yemen|اليمن]] now. And it became so chaotic, it became such a civil war that different factions of [[Yemen|اليمن]] were fighting amongst each other. So [[Yemen|اليمن]] became disunified and it became disunited, and different people were ruling different parts of [[Yemen|اليمن]], and it was just a big mess, it was full of chaos.
So during this period of political instability when there was no central government ruling the country...
